explanation: This route is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because msg_id, user_id, and c_time are percent-formatted directly into the INSERT query string. If session['logged_id'] contains untrusted characters or msg_id is passed outside the int route constraint, it could manipulate the SQL command. The repair replaces string formatting with unquoted %s placeholders and passes (msg_id, user_id, c_time) as a parameter tuple to cursor.execute().
